notes: Left 4 Dead 2 audio stutter fix, clean vanilla audio isolation, and Future Rot VGUI font release: completely eliminated audio-related framerate drops and sound hitching by compiling pre-cached sound.cache directly into addons/runetify.vpk, ensuring instant audio memory streaming; isolated 100% of custom sounds inside runetify.vpk and automatically purged loose audio folders from left4dead2/sound/ to keep vanilla game audio pristine; compiled Future Rot font into encrypted Valve .vfont format (Futurot.vfont, FutureRot.vfont) and updated CustomFontFiles to fix VGUI parser loading; removed resolution range limitations from HUD fonts; protected user configs (autoexec.cfg, video.txt, resolution, binds); cleaned up deprecated disaster/kill commands; and synchronized mod packages v0.2.223.
